title: Borrowed knives
text: Two houses feud over harbor dues and both want YOUR name on their side of the petition. Refusing both is also a statement.

effects.tpl: You pick the winner early and the winner remembers. The loser does too. +15 prestige, −6 karma.

then.tpl: You talk both houses down from the ledge. The city calls you the peacemaker. +25 prestige, +8 karma.

else.tpl: The talks collapse and both sides blame the mediator. −10 prestige.

effects.tpl: You plead harvest, headache, anything. The feud burns on without you.
